column1: # Swedish (sv) catalog for the whole CFA4 interface (Qt GUI and egui). Same format as es.tsv:
# context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Swedish video-editing vocabulary (tidslinje, spår, klipp, sekvens, mapp, uppspelningshuvud,
# markör, övergång, nyckelbildruta). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product
# UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Commands are imperative verbs ("Spara
# som…"), labels use sentence case, quotation marks are ”…”, and product and format names (CFA4,
# Lumetri, ProRes, AAF, EDL…) keep their spelling. Decimal comma (0,5). A native-speaker review is
# welcome.
# Terms: clip = klipp, track = spår, sequence = sekvens, timeline = tidslinje, bin = mapp, playhead
# = uppspelningshuvud, marker = markör, In/Out point = in-/utpunkt, keyframe = nyckelbildruta,
# frame = bildruta, caption = undertext, preset = förinställning, workspace = arbetsyta, gain =
# förstärkning, opacity = opacitet, render = rendera, ripple = rippel-, dissolve = övertoning, wipe
# = svep, transcript = transkription, voice-over = berättarröst, media = media, proxy = proxyfil,
# (Legacy) = (äldre).
# Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (CFA4 contributors), except the section imported from craft-i18n at
# the end (MIT OR Apache-2.0); see sv.tsv.attribution.
